guideline: Annotators were asked to rate conversations from both synthetic sources and actual dialogue sources according to the following dimensions and instructions; • On-Topic: Does the dialogue demonstrate the stated social norm? Option: 1 (Yes) or 0 (No) • Naturalness: How natural is the overall dialogue? How realistic does the content sound? Scale: 1 (completely unnatural) to 5 (as natural as conversations in real life) • Nativeness: Does the dialogue sound native in its language? Scale: 1 (not native at all) to 5 (as native as what a native Chinese speaker would say) • Coherent: How coherent is the overall dialogue? Scale: 1 (completely incoherent) to 5 (as coherent as a native speaker) • Interesting: How interesting is the overall dialogue? Scale: 1 (generic and dull) to 5 (full of content and very engaging)
Annotators rate generated dialogues on naturalness, nativeness, coherence, and interestingness using a 5-point Likert scale.
